items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: The first time I actually worked with him was at the Newport Jazz Festival.

ctx.x: one thing I forgot to ask you about, I'm sorry. You told me that you had worked with Thelonius Monk.
Yes, I worked with Thelonius. The first time I actually worked with him was at the Newport Jazz Festival. I worked with him on one of the sets, you know, and this took place in 1964.
Oh, you worked with him in 1964, uh-huh.
